description: This file defines functions related to media learning tasks, including retrieval and registration of specific learning tasks such as 'WillPlay', 'ConsecutiveBadWindows', and 'ConsecutiveNNRs'. It manages task configurations, features, and reporting settings.

methods.name: GetWillPlayTask
methods.description: Returns a static reference to the 'WillPlay' learning task, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: PushWMPIFeatures
methods.description: Adds specific features related to WMPI to a given LearningTask.

methods.name: GetConsecutiveBadWindowsTask
methods.description: Returns a static reference to the 'ConsecutiveBadWindows' learning task, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: GetConsecutiveNNRsTask
methods.description: Returns a static reference to the 'ConsecutiveNNRs' learning task, initializing it if necessary.
